reviews.title: There seems to be something wrong with the “Calories” complication.
reviews.text: The iPhone app reads in “Dietary Energy” from Apple Health correctly, but the Apple Watch complication refuses to update - showing 0 calories despite numerous resets, refreshes, and rebuilding of complications. At the same time, every other metric/complications works and updates appropriately. Specifically, this impacts anyone’s need to see total calories consumer throughout the day on their watch face.

reviews.title: Billing system is unclear
reviews.text: I will preface this by saying that all of the information they are making you pay to access, used to be available for FREE in the health app on your phone. My next issue is that it says you can sign up for $29.99 one time “lifetime” payment. However upon signing up for it and looking at my Apple subscriptions it actually shows that it will renew and bill me again in 12 months. So not really lifetime at all. Also when you look at subscription options in your Apple account there are several annual premium options but no explanation of the difference between each tier.
